title: FOMC minutes — the October 26-27, 2027 meeting (2:00 p.m. ET, three weeks after the decision)
source: EST: the Board's own stated publication rule applied to a meeting date read direct this session, then validated against every minutes entry this calendar already carries. THE RULE is verbatim from federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm, fetched direct 2026-09-06 (HTTP 200, 164,831 bytes): "The minutes of regularly scheduled meetings are released three weeks after the date of the policy decision." THE MEETING is the same page's 2027 panel, "October 26-27", with no SEP asterisk -- Tuesday and Wednesday. Decision day 2027-10-27 plus 21 days is Wednesday 2027-11-17. THE ARITHMETIC IS VALIDATED AGAINST SIX ENTRIES THIS CALENDAR ALREADY HOLDS, 6 of 6 exact: fomc-minutes-2026-10-07 (Sep 15-16 decision + 21), fomc-minutes-2026-11-18 (Oct 27-28 + 21), fomc-minutes-2026-12-30 (Dec 8-9 + 21), fomc-minutes-2027-06-30 (Jun 8-9 + 21), fomc-minutes-2027-08-18 (Jul 27-28 + 21) and fomc-minutes-2027-10-06 (Sep 14-15 + 21). The meeting date itself was recovered as part of a 168-meeting census this session parsed from fifteen Board pages (the current calendar plus fomchistorical2007.htm through fomchistorical2020.htm, HTTP 200 each), which returns exactly 21 years x 8 scheduled meetings with no year off -- and a PARSING TRAP the fomc-minutes-2027-10-06 lane already recorded was cleared the same way here: the 2027 panel's own footnote names a January 25-26, 2028 meeting, so a year-scoped parse of that panel returns a phantom 2027-01-25/26. The 2:00 p.m. ET release time is the Board's standing convention and is not stated on this page. Filed estimate because the rule is firm but the meeting date is TENTATIVE by the page's own words -- "Each meeting date is tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it" -- so the promotion trigger is the 2027-09-14/15 meeting ratifying October 26-27, not a better fetch. notes: DISCOVERED during the fomc-blackout-start-2027-10-16 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-06). THE HOLE: this calendar carries FOMC minutes for 2026-10-07, 2026-11-18, 2026-12-30, 2027-06-30, 2027-08-18 and 2027-10-06 -- but nothing for the October 2027 meeting, which is the exact meeting the parent event's blackout window wraps. WHY IT MATTERS TO THE PARENT, AND WHAT NOT TO CONCLUDE: the parent gate closes at the end of 2027-10-28, and these minutes are the first FULL account of the decision it silenced the Committee around, arriving twenty days after the gate lifts. That is a fact about the communications calendar, NOT a signal. The fomc-minutes-2027-10-06 lane measured minutes days against 4,950 sessions and found the index ordinary -- 157 releases, 0.747% mean absolute move against a 0.797% baseline -- with every apparent implied-vol edge dissolving under a placebo control. Treat this entry as corridor furniture. TWO DISPLACEMENT RISKS TO CARRY FORWARD. (1) If the 2027-09-14/15 meeting ratifies an October meeting other than 26-27, this date moves with it and so does the parent's whole window; the two die together. (2) THE DUPLICATE-ID HAZARD, recorded rather than fixed: two sibling lanes have already proposed the SAME October 2027 meeting under two different ids, fomc-2027-10-26.from-consumer-confidence-2027-10-26.json and fomc-2027-10-27.from-fomc-minutes-2027-10-06.json. Whichever lane researches that meeting should collapse them rather than write both, and this entry deliberately keys off the DECISION day (10-27) so its arithmetic is unambiguous either way. Impact medium matches every other minutes entry. symbols is empty and no house playbook is calendar-keyed. Proposed as an estimate; estimates widen caution only and nothing here licenses an entry.
